_comment: Casalrana's entry on the travel map and its look. Off the map until rice_village_revealed is set, when the bus line reaches it (nothing sets it yet); tests and screenshots reach it with --island=rice_village. look.weather: always clear (late November, bright white skies).
name: Casalrana
desc: A hamlet out on the rice plain after the harvest: frosty stubble, herons in the ditches, and a little station where the trains stopped stopping in 1993.

meter.name: The Petition
meter.about: Paletta's petition to the railway for a stop at Casalrana. The railway wants 250 signatures; Casalrana has 41 inhabitants. Every request you finish spreads the word across the plain, and the signatures come from the next villages, the bus passengers and Matteo's whole school.

milestones.title: Two pages, one in pencil
milestones.desc: The old goods yard beside the station becomes part of your build plot.

milestones.title: The province takes note
milestones.desc: A load of materials arrives: 10 wood, 8 stone, 4 metal and 2 copper wire.

milestones.title: A rubber stamp from the next village
milestones.desc: The next village's council stamps it, and sends 100,000 lire.

milestones.title: The petition is full
milestones.desc: Ingegner Pautasso's third condition is met.

catches.name: Carp
catches.caught: A fat carp! It counts as two.

catches.name: Sleepy Frog
catches.caught: A very sleepy frog! You put it straight back in the mud. Goodnight, frog.
